details.description: Qwen3.8-Max (served on Fireworks AI as "qwen3p8-max") is Qwen's flagship large language model, released as the open-weight checkpoint Qwen/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B: a Mixture-of-Experts model with 2.4 trillion total parameters and 95 billion activated per token, built on the architectural foundation of Qwen3.5. The model card calls it "the most capable generation in the Qwen open-model family to date" and the first time a Qwen-Max-class model has been given an open release, aimed at coding, professional work, research, and long-horizon agentic tasks. Reasoning depth can be tuned with a reasoning_effort setting, and image input is available through Qwen's hosted Qwen3.8-Max product tier, which is what Fireworks serves.
advantages: Scores 92.6 on GPQA Diamond, per Qwen's own benchmark table on the model card.
Scores 86.6 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (agentic coding in a terminal), evaluated with the Claude Code harness per the model card.
Scores 67.7 on SWE-bench Pro (real-world software engineering), per the model card.
Supports function calling / tool use, per Fireworks AI's model page.
Reasoning depth can be tuned via a reasoning_effort parameter (xhigh, medium, low), and prior thinking context can be retained via preserve_thinking, per the model card.
disadvantages: Fine-tuning is not supported on Fireworks' serverless offering of this model, per Fireworks AI's model page.
The open-weight checkpoint itself is text-only; vision input is documented as a feature of Qwen's separately hosted Qwen3.8-Max product tier, not the raw checkpoint, per the model card.
Released under Qwen's own model license rather than a standard open-source license such as Apache 2.0, per the Hugging Face license tag.
use_cases: Complex, multi-step coding and software engineering tasks
Long-horizon agentic workflows requiring autonomous planning and tool use
Professional research, legal, finance, and health-related analysis tasks (per the model card's PLawBench, PRBench, and HealthBench results)
General reasoning tasks with adjustable thinking depth

sources.title: Qwen 3.8 Max API & Playground | Fireworks AI

notes: Both target URIs (accounts/fireworks/models/qwen3p8-max and fireworks_ai/qwen3p8-max) resolve to the same Fireworks listing, 'Qwen 3.8 Max', which links to the Hugging Face checkpoint Qwen/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B (2.4T total / 95B active MoE) -- confirmed by reading both pages' rendered content directly, since this model postdates my training data. Fireworks' page lists 'Support image input: Supported', matching the catalog's image_input modality and the model card's note that the hosted Qwen3.8-Max product tier (as opposed to the raw open checkpoint alone) adds vision input; kept the catalog's facts (262,144 max input tokens, image_input+text_input+text_output modality) as authoritative and did not restate the model card's larger 1,010,000-token extended-context figure. Benchmark table on the model card compares Qwen3.8-Max against other vendors' models (Opus 4.8, GPT 5.6 Sol, etc.); only Qwen3.8-Max's own scores are reported above, per the guidance against relative/competitive claims.
